name: Please Big Cubes Korea 2025

venue.name: [도봉구민회관 (DoBong-Gu Hall)](http://www.dobongsiseol.or.kr/index_hall.html)
venue.address: 서울특별시 도봉구 도봉로 552 (552, Dobong-ro, Dobong-gu, Seoul)

information:
## [참관객 제한](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBigCubesKorea2025#58740-spectator-restriction)이 존재합니다.
WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NationalScienceMuseum2025#55989-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NationalScienceMuseum2025#55988-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오.

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](rg/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___

## There is a [Spectator Limit](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBigCubesKorea2025#58740-spectator-restriction).
If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NationalScienceMuseum2025#55989-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NationalScienceMuseum2025#55988-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering.

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request.

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.
